intro.title: Secure Token Rotation
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build a secure Angular service that automatically refreshes authentication tokens before they expire. You'll learn how to implement token rotation using Angular's HttpClient and RxJS observables to make API calls. The core programming concept involves managing asynchronous operations and handling HTTP interceptors. You'll work with TypeScript interfaces, services, and HTTP headers to create a production-ready authentication flow.
intro.usecase: Secure token rotation is essential in any application that maintains user sessions, such as banking dashboards, e-commerce platforms, or healthcare portals. When users remain logged in for extended periods while performing sensitive operations like financial transactions or viewing medical records, their access tokens must be refreshed periodically without disrupting the experience. This pattern prevents unauthorized access by automatically replacing expired tokens with new ones, ensuring continuous security without requiring manual re-login. Developers implement this in authentication services to maintain seamless, secure user sessions across all protected routes and API calls.
